annotations.title: Legal help options for a legal problem

description: Use when the person asks for a lawyer or legal help but has not chosen a lawyer yet, including short requests like "I need a lawyer". From their short description of the legal need (plus state, city and legal problem if they named them), it returns: up to five listed lawyers when the matter and state are known (in the listing's own order), local legal aid and court self-help with sources and dates, fees a lawyer published, the official license-check site, and at most one follow-up question. Read-only: it stores nothing, sends nothing and contacts no one.

city.description: City the person already named, if any.

legal_problem.description: A few words for the legal problem the person already named, if any (for example "eviction").

message.description: Short description of the legal need in the person's words (for example "I need a lawyer for my eviction in Fresno"). Used only to read the type of problem, the place and any deadline or cost concern; not stored.

state.description: Two-letter U.S. state the person already named, if any.
